description: messy/trap: mixed German/English, an abbreviation (ITS = Intensivstation) instead of the full word, and experience given as a date range (03/2018-09/2023, ~5.5y) rather than 'X Jahre' -- plus a birth year ('geboren 1990') as a distractor. The deterministic path's date-range fallback (max year minus min year, when no explicit 'X Jahre' phrase is found) has no way to tell a birth year from a career-start year, so it grabs the birth year too and computes 2023-1990=33 (capped at 30) instead of ~5. LLM won this one decisively, see evals/cv/README.md
